movies.title: A Christmas Story
movies.cast: Peter Billingsley, Darren McGavin, Melinda Dillon, Ian Petrella
movies.description: While Bob Clark holds a special place in our dark hearts for his inventive horror flicks like the scary treat Black Christmas , it’s his contribution to the American canon of holiday classics with A Christmas Story that solidifies him as one of our favorite directors. Quirky family dynamics, a leg lamp, a bunny suit, bullying, swear words and anorexia are all involved in one boy’s quest for a Red Ryder B.B. gun in the 1940s. With such sincerity and deep humor, make a switch from watching this on television this year and see it on the big screen with your Nitehawk family!

movies.title: Accident
movies.director: Joseph Losey Screenplay by Harold Pinter Based on the 1965 novel Accident by Nicholas Mosley
movies.cast: Dirk Bogarde, Stanley Baker, Jacqueline Sassard, Michael York, Vivien Merchant, Delphine Seyrig, Alexander Knox
movies.description: A country home on a warm summer night; the sound of a sickening car crash; a startled horse; a white-clad woman with a feathery boa; a curious dog. A long Sunday that begins with guests, expected and unexpected, arriving for lunch, and then staying for supper, and then overnight; interspersed with clumsy tennis, near-silent walks through an idyllic countryside, drinkers upending their beer glasses to clear for the whiskey, and... “What room is everybody in?” Oxford don Dirk Bogarde’s mid-life crisis, struggling with the tensions, rivalries, lusts and distrusts shared with his students Michael York and Jacqueline Sassard, pregnant wife Vivien Merchant, and unpleasant bespectacled colleague Stanley Baker, as the flashbacks unfold à la Alain Resnais, including a wispy, dreamlike reunion with old flame Delphine Seyrig (LAST YEAR AT MARIENBAD).

movies.title: Air Mail
movies.cast: Pat O’Brien, Ralph Bellamy, Gloria Stuart, Slim Summerville, Lilian Bond, Russell Hopton
movies.description: Before Howard Hawks’ aviation melodrama Only Angels Have Wings , director John Ford hoisted Depression-era audiences up, up, and away to a cockpit-level view of airmail delivery! Ford’s trademark penchant for the American West provides a perilous backdrop to the surprisingly sensational workaday lives of thrill-junkie postal pilots, centering on a reckless daredevil who won’t let anything – a pal, a dame, or even the Christmas shipping rush! – clip his flight feathers.
notes: Presented in 35mm
Hosted by Caroline Golum and Cristina Cacioppo

movies.title: American Psycho
movies.cast: Christian Bale, Justin Theroux, Josh Lucas, Bill Sage, Chloë Sevigny, Reese Witherspoon
movies.description:
“Look at that subtle off-white coloring. The tasteful thickness of it. Oh, my God. It even has a watermark.”

Before Christian Bale was the savior of Gotham, he was the chainsaw-wielding, business card-slinging scourge of Manhattan. Caught during the height of American Yuppieism in the late '80s, Patrick Bateman finds himself surrounded by friends who he hates and a culture he can’t stand. Can anyone blame him for allowing his nightly bloodlust to overflow into the day?

It’s hard to imagine anyone aside from Bale lecturing a soon-to-be victim on the cultural undertones found within Huey Lewis and The News’ “Hip to be Square,” all while wearing a raincoat and holding an incredibly shiny axe. But, what now seems meant to be almost wasn’t! The role was originally offered to none other than Leonardo DiCaprio. However, due to his newfound fame within the teenaged female demographic, Leo’s managers felt that a stint as a sociopathic mass murderer might somehow taint his image. I guess a career in murders and executions isn’t for everyone.

Now, if you’ll excuse me, I have to return some videotapes.

movies.cast: Andrew Garfield, Monica Barbaro, Billie Lourd, Mark Rylance, Chris O’Dowd, Cooper Hoffman, Ike Barinholtz, Jason Schwartzman, Zosia Mamet
movies.description: A comedic drama set in the world of artificial intelligence, around the period at OpenAI in 2023 that saw CEO Sam Altman fired and rehired in a matter of days.

When a computer scientist and AI pioneer Professor Geoffrey Hinton makes a breakthrough they are certain will alter humanity forever, Sam Altman, Elon Musk and the most prominent figures in Silicon Valley race to become part of their vision. As the technology becomes more powerful and more valuable than anyone ever imagined, a battle wages over who should control the tech that could change the fate of humanity.

movies.cast: Robert Downey Jr., Pedro Pascal, Chris Hemsworth, Vanessa Kirby, Anthony Mackie, Sebastian Stan, Ebon Moss-Bachrach, Simu Liu, Florence Pugh

movies.title: Back to the Beach
movies.cast: Frankie Avalon, Annette Funicello, Lori Loughlin, Tommy Hinkley, Demian Slade, Joe Holland
movies.description:
Life can be hard for a stressed out car salesman in Ohio, even if you have the perfect wife and two children to carry on your legacy. But, when the husband and wife are played by Frankie Avalon and Annette Funicello, the beach will always call them back to its sandy shores. The beach blanket power couple are drawn to California to visit daughter Sandi (Lori Loughlin) on the way to Hawaii and get waylaid to help her sort out her life. The family soon encounters a series of hiccups that keep them in Cali longer than planned, but they have some fun along the way. The band Fishbone stops by to get groovy, Paul Reubens' Pee-wee Herman celebrates on the beach, and we get even more musical with Stevie Ray Vaughan and Dick Dale. All of this with more polka dots than you can shake a surfboard at. BACK TO THE BEACH might not make sense, but dammit it is fun. (Dede Crimmins)

movies.title: Bad Santa
movies.cast: Billy Bob Thornton, Bernie Mac, Lauren Graham, Tony Cox, Brett Kelly, Lauren Tom, John Ritter
movies.description: In this dark comedy, the crotchety Willie (Billy Bob Thornton) and his partner (Tony Cox) reunite once a year for a holiday con. Posing as a mall Santa and his elf, they rip off shopping outlets on Christmas Eve. This year, however, Willie is falling apart. He’s depressed and alcoholic, and his erratic behavior draws the suspicion of mall security (Bernie Mac). But when befriending a small boy brings out his kinder side, Willie begins to wonder if there is still some hope for him.

movies.title: Beginners
movies.cast: Ewan McGregor, Mélanie Laurent, Christopher Plummer, Goran Visnjic, Mary Page Keller, Kai Lennox
movies.description: Mike Mills’ Beginners imaginatively explores the hilarity, confusion, and surprises of love through the evolving consciousness of Oliver (Ewan McGregor). Oliver meets the irreverent and unpredictable Anna (Mélanie Laurent) only months after his father Hal Fields (Christopher Plummer) has passed away. This new love floods Oliver with memories of his father, who, following the death of his wife of 45 years, came out of the closet at age 75 to live a full, energized, and wonderfully tumultuous gay life – which included a younger boyfriend, Andy (Goran Visnjic). The upheavals of Hal’s new honesty, by turns funny and moving, brought father and son closer than they’d ever been able to be. Now Oliver endeavors to love Anna with all the bravery, humor, and hope that his father taught him.

movies.title: Behemoth!
movies.cast: Pedro Pascal, Olivia Wilde, Eva Victor, Will Arnett, Hank Azaria, Alexa Swinton
movies.description: A gifted cellist, Alex Serian (Pedro Pascal), returns home to Los Angeles after 20 years on the road. Music, which has been the constant, all-consuming river of his life, begins to carry Alex on an adventure that will change him forever.

movies.description: The BILLY JOEL TONIGHT concert film contains the original December 1976 performances from Connecticut College. Broadcast as a television special in 1977, this newly transferred, edited, restored, and mixed version captures Joel and his band at a crucial moment just before mainstream success arrived. Featured songs include “Captain Jack,” “New York State of Mind,” “Piano Man,” and many more.

movies.title: Birth
movies.cast: Nicole Kidman, Cameron Bright, Danny Huston, Lauren Bacall, Alison Elliott, Arliss Howard

showtimes.label: Weird Wednesday · Lower Manhattan · Sold out

movies.description:
Ten years after her husband suddenly died, Anna (Nicole Kidman) has finally restarted her life and accepted a marriage proposal from her boyfriend. At the engagement party, a stranger wanders in to announce that he's Anna's dead husband. That stranger is a ten-year-old boy. Against her better judgment, Anna decides to hear him out.

Arguably the apex of a stretch of roles proving her to be the most adventurous movie star of her generation, Nicole Kidman gives a pitch-perfect performance in the chilly world Jonathan Glazer creates in BIRTH. (Mike Keegan)

movies.cast: Cameron Winter
movies.description:
Cameron Winter, in December 2025, after a months-long sold-out tour with his band Geese, returned to New York to play a single show at Carnegie Hall. This is the movie.

Directed and shot on 35mm and 16mm by Oscar-winning filmmaker Paul Thomas Anderson (ONE BATTLE AFTER ANOTHER), the crew includes filmmaker and actor Benny Safdie (THE SMASHING MACHINE) and music producer Ariel Rechtshaid (Grammy winner for albums with Vampire Weekend and Adele).

GQ praised Cameron Winter’s show at Carnegie Hall as “staggeringly good,” and Nick Cave said he has "a glorious, emotive voice with brilliant, blistering words, a racked and wondrous thing.” Winter’s solo album Heavy Metal was named one of the best of the year by Pitchfork , Rolling Stone , Paste , and Mojo , and Geese’s last record Getting Killed was named the best album of 2025 by The New Yorker , NME , and Stereogum .

movies.cast: Cate Blanchett, Rooney Mara, Sarah Paulson, Kyle Chandler
movies.description: In an adaptation of Patricia Highsmith’s seminal novel The Price of Salt , CAROL follows two women from very different backgrounds who find themselves in an unexpected love affair in 1950s New York. As conventional norms of the time challenge their undeniable attraction, an honest story emerges to reveal the resilience of the heart in the face of change. A young woman in her 20s, Therese Belivet (Rooney Mara), is a clerk working in a Manhattan department store and dreaming of a more fulfilling life when she meets Carol (Cate Blanchett), an alluring woman trapped in a loveless, convenient marriage. As an immediate connection sparks between them, the innocence of their first encounter dims and their connection deepens. While Carol breaks free from the confines of marriage, her husband (Kyle Chandler) begins to question her competence as a mother as her involvement with Therese and close relationship with her best friend Abby (Sarah Paulson) come to light.

At the age of 17, Frank Abagnale, Jr. becomes the most successful bank robber in the history of the U.S. FBI Agent Carl Hanratty makes it his prime mission to capture Frank and bring him to justice, but Frank is always one step ahead of him.

movies.cast: Sophie Okonedo, David Oyelowo, India Amarteifio, Toheeb Jimoh, Ayo Edebiri
movies.description: Across a single day in Lagos, Nigeria, Clarissa (Sophie Okonedo) prepares to host a high society party at her home, as her complicated past begins to consume her, in the form of now-distant friends and loves from her youth. Simultaneously, Septimus (Fortune Nwafor), a young soldier, is haunted by his own memories of the horrors he has witnessed and endured. As the perspectives traverse past and present, across the bourgeois class and those too easily forgotten by society, a delicate portrait of contemporary Nigeria emerges. Directors Arie and Chuko, adapting Mrs. Dalloway by Virginia Woolf, take the renowned source material and deliver a unique and deeply felt story.

movies.title: Dead City Punx
movies.description:
When COVID shut down venues in 2020, Los Angeles punk band Dead City Punx took their shows to the people—outside, under freeway overpasses, up the coast, to the desert and in otherwise abandoned spaces. Starting with their explosive breakout performance in Lafayette Park that drew nearly 5,000 fans while under fire from LAPD rubber bullets, this group of graffiti writers/musicians became LA’s most notorious DIY act.

Born from stolen equipment and street life connections, the band—Meka, Grumpy, Mike, and Adrian—built stages for their shows from shoplifted wood, used social media as their “bat signal,” and turned every performance into a crime scene complete with graffiti backdrops, bonfires, and police helicopters.

Through fan-filmed concert footage and exclusive interviews, Dead City Punx captures how four outcasts from society’s margins ignited a pandemic-era music movement that challenged definitions of public space, rebellion, and the right to assemble. BEYOND THE STREETS presents the story of Dead City Punx —raw, unfiltered and as real as their shows.

movies.title: Dog Star Man
movies.cast: Stan Brakhage, Jane Wodening
movies.description:
A man and his dog struggle up a snow-covered mountain. The sun erupts, blood courses through veins, bodies merge with landscapes, and the boundaries between the microscopic and the cosmic dissolve. In Stan Brakhage’s monumental DOG STAR MAN (1961–64), a simple ascent becomes an ecstatic journey through the origins of life, the mysteries of perception, and the possibility of creating myth through cinema.

One of the towering achievements of American avant-garde filmmaking, this five-part epic (Prelude and Parts I–IV) abandons conventional narrative in favor of a radical exploration of vision itself. Through a dazzling interplay of superimpositions, shifting colors, fractured perspectives, and images of the natural world and the human body, Brakhage transforms a physical struggle into a spiritual and cosmic odyssey. Filmed with the collaboration of his wife, Jane Brakhage, and featuring the filmmaker himself and his dog as its protagonists, DOG STAR MAN collapses distinctions between inner and outer worlds, memory and imagination, the human and the universal.

DOG STAR MAN was selected for preservation and inducted into the National Film Registry by the Library of Congress in 1992.

Conceived by Brakhage as an intentionally silent work, in which the images themselves generate their own rhythm and music, DOG STAR MAN will be presented in its entirety on 16mm with a live, original musical accompaniment by The Flushing Remonstrance, the New York City-based duo of Catherine Cramer (percussion, electronics) and Robert Kennedy (keyboards, electronics, voice). Known for their adventurous sonic interpretations of silent and experimental cinema, including works by Kenneth Anger, Guy Maddin, and Dziga Vertov, the duo offers a contemporary sonic encounter with Brakhage's extraordinary universe of images.

movies.cast: Timothée Chalamet, Zendaya, Jason Momoa, Hassam Ghancy, Robert Pattinson, Florence Pugh, Anya Taylor-Joy, Rebecca Ferguson, Javier Bardem
movies.description: Dune: Part Three is set nearly two decades after Paul Atreides seized control of the Imperium. Now a ruthless Emperor, Paul must face the consequences of his reign as old allies return, terrifying new threats emerge, and betrayal lurks in every shadow. Haunted by visions of Imperial collapse and the reappearance of his long-lost love, Paul is drawn into a sweeping conspiracy, with Chani at the heart of its unfolding mystery. As rebellion brews and enemies close in, Paul must confront the true cost of power and the fate of those he loves the most.

movies.cast: Timothée Chalamet, Zendaya, Jason Momoa, Hassam Ghancy, Robert Pattinson, Florence Pugh, Anya Taylor-Joy, Rebecca Ferguson, Javier Bardem

With old allies returning, new enemies emerging, and a conspiracy threatening his empire, Paul must navigate shifting loyalties and the consequences of his rise to power. The reappearance of a long-lost love further complicates matters, while Chani (Zendaya) is at the center of a mystery that could shape the future of the Imperium. Directed by Denis Villeneuve, Dune: Part Three continues the epic science-fiction saga with an ensemble cast including Florence Pugh, Robert Pattinson, and Rebecca Ferguson.

Now Paul Atreides is an emperor, Chani is back, rebellion is brewing, and the bill for all that power has finally come due. Zendaya caps a truly impressive 2026 in the hugely anticipated finale that demands the biggest screen you can find.

movies.title: Elf
movies.cast: Will Ferrell, James Caan, Bob Newhart, Edward Asner, Mary Steenburgen, Zooey Deschanel
movies.description: Elf is a mix between the misfit story of Rudolph the Red Nosed Reindeer and the “believe in miracles” story of A Christmas Carol but with the added joy of Will Ferrell in an elf suit running around New York City. Starring as Buddy, one year he crawls into Santa’s toy bag as a baby and gets whisked off to the North Pole where he gets raised as an elf. Of course, he’s a tall fish out of water and eventually decides to head to his birthplace to meet his father. What he finds is a family and a city who have forgotten the meaning of Christmas so he sets out to save the holiday!

movies.title: Enter the Void
movies.cast: Nathaniel Brown, Paz de la Huerta, Cyril Roy, Ed Spear
movies.description:
Provocative, audacious and visionary, Gaspar Noé ( Irreversible ) pushes the boundaries of hallucinatory cinema with this exploration of sex, drugs, life and death. A brother and sister scratch out a living in Tokyo’s underworld–Oscar’s a small-time dealer, Linda (Paz de la Huerta, The Limits of Control ) is an exotic dancer. One night, a police bust goes horribly wrong, and Oscar is shot. But as he lies dying, his spirit refuses to leave the world. Instead, it wanders through the city, its visions growing ever more distorted and nightmarish.

“Four stars! A tour de force… strong contender for both the artiest drug movie and the druggiest art movie ever made… [the climax] leaves you dazed, elated and absolutely awestruck.” – David Fear, Time Out New York

“Terrifying and surpassingly beautiful… a revolutionary break from ordinary movie storytelling… daring, thrilling… with this movie Noe jumps to the front rank of mindf**k acid-trip filmmakers, right next to David Lynch, and I wandered out afterwards… feeling dazzled, dizzy, exhausted, grateful… love, hate, disgust, arousal, amazement — all are appropriate reactions to one of the most mind-blowing and ambitious feature films ever made.” – Andrew O’Hehir, Salon

Screening as part of Late Night Favorites: Fall 2026

Previously screened as part of our 2025 series 20 Films for 20 Years and our 2022 series Too Much Is Never Enough: The Films of Gaspar Noé

movies.title: Eyes Wide Shut
movies.cast: Tom Cruise, Nicole Kidman, Todd Field, Sydney Pollack
movies.description: After a provocative Christmas party hosted by the wealthy and unconventional Victor Ziegler, Dr. Bill Hartford and his wife Alice (played by at-the-time real-life couple Tom Cruise and Nicole Kidman) set sail on a psychosexual journey caught between reality and illusion, jealousy and obsession. When Alice admits to have sexual fantasies about a man she met, Bill becomes hell bent on having an illicit encounter but after he sneaks into a secret society sex party, he quickly discovers he’s in way over his head. With its intimate dialogue and sweepingly vibrant scenes, Eyes Wide Shut is a befitting finale to Kubrick’s stunning cinematic legacy.

movies.title: Eyes Wide Shut
movies.cast: Tom Cruise, Nicole Kidman, Todd Field, Sydney Pollack
movies.description:
In IT’S A WONDERFUL LIFE, Jimmy Stewart’s George Bailey, at the height of his suicidal despair and panic, imagines a world in which he doesn’t exist. Stanley Kubrick goes one step further in sending Tom Cruise down an odyssey of sexual confusion and paranoia to learn the true meaning of Christmas.

Adapted from the Austrian short story Traumnovelle , Kubrick’s final film peeks us into the privileged world of Dr. Bill Hartford and his wife Alice (Cruise and Nicole Kidman), two well-to-do attractive socialites who, by all accounts, have it made. In a marijuana-fueled argument, Alice reveals thoughts of infidelity that send Bill into an existential panic, leading to an absurdist walkabout through New York that involves – you guessed it – a mysterious sex cult run by a shrouded aristocracy.

Did Kubrick make this to break up Cruise and Kidman’s marriage? How much did he know about mysterious sex trafficking rings? Did Sydney Pollack originate the shirtless-in-suspenders look? Clearly, the film poses more questions than it answers. For certain, EYES WIDE SHUT is a brutally funny sexscapade that puts an ellipses at the end of Kubrick’s storied career – and, most importantly – stands as a crucial text for our modern world. Fidelio!

movies.title: Fiddler on the Roof
movies.cast: Topol, Norma Crane, Leonard Frey, Molly Picon, Paul Mann
movies.description: A lavishly produced and critically acclaimed screen adaptation of the international stage sensation tells the life-affirming story of Tevye, a poor milkman whose love, pride and faith help him face the oppression of turn-of-the-century czarist Russia.

movies.title: Game
movies.cast: Dulquer Salmaan, Kayadu Lohar, Antony Varghese, Mysskin, Kathir, Samyuktha Viswanathan
movies.description: In late summer 1993, a tense and claustrophobic battle of wills and wits unfolds after aging raver David (Marc Bessant) steals a stash of money and drugs, then crashes his car deep in the woods. Trapped in the wreckage, injured and helpless, he hangs suspended between life and death. When a mysterious poacher (Jason Williamson) discovers him, no rescue comes – only a watchful, unsettling presence that seems intent on letting nature finish the job. As the hours stretch and the elements close in, survival hinges on outlasting both the wilderness and the predator at its edge.

movies.title: Gassan + Woman of Tokyo
movies.description: At the twilight of his life, a man spends the winter in a village at the foot of Mount Gassan, a holy site venerated for millennia. Finding refuge in a snow-buried temple, he has a mystical experience on the frontiers of the living and the dead. The Theater of the Matters is proud to present the first US screening of Shinji Somai’s rare and deeply personal final film, completed shortly before the director’s death from cancer in 2001. Produced as an installment in “Reading Journey: Masterpieces of Japan,” an experimental public television program, Gassan is a marvel of spare means: shot on location in just four days with an HD camera, one performer, and a small crew. In a series of intricately orchestrated long takes, actor Akira Emoto recites the text of the eponymous 1974 novel by Atsushi Mori, a fictionalized account of the writer’s travels in remote Northern Japan, suffused with the region’s language and folk traditions. Gassan will be followed by a 35mm screening of Woman of Tokyo , a furious, oblique Depression-era silent film by Somai favorite Yasujiro Ozu, presented without accompaniment. Gassan (2001) Dir. Shinji Somai With Akira Emoto 52min; Digital In Japanese with English subtitles Woman of Tokyo (1933) Dir. Yasujiro Ozu With Yoshiko Okada, Ureo Egawa 45min; 35mm In Japanese intertitles with English subtitles

movies.title: Gremlins
movies.cast: Zach Galligan, Hoyt Axton, Frances Lee McCain, Phoebe Cates, Polly Holliday, Scott Brady, Corey Feldman, Dick Miller
movies.description:
There are only three rules to abide when owning a Mogwai: keep them away from bright light, never make them wet and never, ever feed them after midnight.

So when young Peter accidentally breaks two of the three rules with cutie pie pre-Christmas present Gizmo, he unleashes an ugly copy of terrorizers known as Gremlins. As they are designed to do, the Gremlins wreak havoc upon Pete’s small town and have a particular interest in electronics and mechanical devices. Consider this movie the ultimate pet-ownership guide.

movies.title: Hallucinations
movies.director: Mark Polonia, Todd Michael Smith, John Polonia
movies.cast: John Polonia, Mark Polonia, Todd Michael Smith
movies.description: HALLUCINATIONS is an essential manifestation from the 1980s shot-on-video horror wave. Filmed on a family camcorder during the dead of winter in Pennsylvania, this is a warped take on POLTERGEIST from siblings Mark and John Polonia with friend (and future gay underground filmmaker) Todd Michael Smith. Eerie, surreal, and containing surprisingly thoughtful themes, HALLUCINATIONS is an impressive mix of splatter-filled chaos and homoerotic phantasms. (Joseph A. Ziemba, Bleeding Skull)

movies.title: Heat
movies.cast: Burt Reynolds, Karen Young, Peter MacNicol, Howard Hesseman, Neill Barry
movies.description:
It’s a Vegas Christmas with a grumpy Burt Reynolds!

Nick Escalante (Reynolds) is a tough guy ex-mercenary wallowing in Las Vegas, where he uses his muscle as a bodyguard for hire. Spending his free time gambling, he is trying to save up enough “Fuck You Money” to get out of the country. When a female friend is brutalized by local bad guys, he can’t help but get involved.

A slick and fun ‘80s thriller that you probably never heard of, this might be the third best movie with the title Heat , but between its colorful Vegas setting and its completely absurd villain death, it is a gift you should give yourself this holiday season.
notes: Presented in 35mm

movies.title: High School High
movies.cast: Jon Lovitz, Tia Carrere, Mekhi Phifer, Louise Fletcher, Malinda Williams
movies.description:
Richard Clark has just left the well-known Wellington Academy to teach at Marion Barry High School. Now, he will try to inspire the D-average students into making good grades and try to woo a fellow teacher.

“For this staff pick, I tried a divination exercise to determine which movie I wanted to screen. I opened Letterboxd on my phone and put it under my pillow before going to bed. I had many vivid dreams that evening. It felt like i had lived lifetimes. I ended up sleeping 15 hours and when I woke up I had one movie visualized in my mind clearly: HIGH SCHOOL HIGH.”

Staff pick by Sebastian Becerra, projectionist

Screening as part of our series Staff Picks 2026

movies.title: How the Grinch Stole Christmas
movies.cast: Jim Carrey, Taylor Momsen, Jeffrey Tambor, Christine Baranski, Bill Irwin, Molly Shannon
movies.description:
Based on the beloved book by Dr. Seuss, HOW THE GRINCH STOLE CHRISTMAS is sure to entertain even the biggest Scrooge.

Jim Carrey plays the gleefully mischievous Grinch who wages war on the holiday celebrations in nearby Whoville until he meets Cindy Lou (Taylor Momsen), a kindhearted girl who teaches him the true spirit of Christmas.

movies.title: Hundreds of Beavers
movies.cast: Ryland Brickson Cole Tews, Olivia Graves, Wes Tank, Doug Mancheski, Luis Rico
movies.description:
A slapstick epic about a frostbitten battle between Jean Kayak and diabolical beavers–hundreds of them–who stand between him and survival. Our annual run of the holiday classic — chosen as one of Time Out New York’ s “New York Essentials”!

movies.title: Joan of Arc
movies.cast: Ingrid Bergman
movies.description: “From the time I was a little girl, [Joan of Arc] has always been my greatest heroine,” recalled Ingrid Bergman. “Instead of saving butterflies or stamps, my hobby was to look for things about Joan of Arc, and to collect books and medals and statues of her... She became the character I liked to play most.” Bergman spent her first decade in Hollywood trying to persuade producers to give her an opportunity to play the Maid of Orleans. (“There’s no love story in it,” sniffed David O. Selznick.) Finally Bergman played the role on stage in Maxwell Anderson’s Joan of Lorraine , winning a Tony for her performance. Anderson adapted the play to the screen for this lavish independent production, shot in Technicolor at the Hal Roach Studio under the direction of Victor Fleming, who had guided Bergman through her early triumph in DR. JEKYLL AND MR. HYDE (1941). The epic rendition of Joan’s military campaign and trial was accorded road show treatment before being cut by 45 minutes for general release. JOAN OF ARC won Academy Awards® for its cinematography and costumes, and producer Walter Wanger received a special honorary Oscar® for “distinguished service to the industry in adding to its moral stature in the world community by his production of the picture Joan of Arc”—an honor he refused because the Academy had failed to supply a Best Picture nomination, too.

movies.cast: Kate Winslet, Jennifer Connelly, Patrick Wilson
movies.description: Sarah (Kate Winslet) is a well-educated woman who cannot come to terms with her life as a housewife and mother. Brad (Patrick Wilson), a stay-at-home dad, is married to a beautiful filmmaker (Jennifer Connelly) and goes skateboarding instead of studying for the bar exam. The pair meet at a playground and soon begin having secret trysts while their children nap and their spouses are at work.

movies.title: Little Mother
movies.cast: Christiane Krüger, Siegfried Rauch, Ivan Desny, Mark Damon, Anton Diffring, Elga Sorbas
movies.description:
Marina Pinares, the wife of the president of a South American country, insists on being his vice-presidential running mate in the next election. She's no stranger to assassination to get what she wants, so some suspect she'll kill her own husband after the election to become president. In a series of flashbacks we see her rise to power: a party girl willing to sacrifice a friend's virtue to gain favor; the lover of a soldier she later tortures; the mistress of the military man she soon marries.

Based on the life of Eva Peron and directed by adult filmmaker Radley Metzger (SCORE, THE OPENING OF MISTY BEETHOVEN), LITTLE MOTHER is a rarely-seen tale of political intrigue that's ready for rediscovery.

movies.title: Little Women
movies.cast: Florence Pugh, Timothée Chalamet, Emma Watson, Saoirse Ronan, Eliza Scanlen, Meryl Streep, Laura Dern, Bob Odenkirk
movies.description: Writer-director Greta Gerwig ( Lady Bird ) has crafted a Little Women that draws on both the classic novel and the writings of Louisa May Alcott, and unfolds as the author’s alter ego, Jo March, reflects back and forth on her fictional life. In Gerwig’s take, the beloved story of the March sisters – four young women each determined to live life on her own terms — is both timeless and timely. Portraying Jo, Meg, Amy, and Beth March, the film stars Saoirse Ronan, Emma Watson, Florence Pugh, Eliza Scanlen, with Timothée Chalamet as their neighbor Laurie, Laura Dern as Marmee, and Meryl Streep as Aunt March.
notes: Accessibility: Closed Captions, Assisted Listening, Descriptive Audio

movies.description:
Having already once revolutionized the coming-of-age story with her debut LADY BIRD, Greta Gerwig has somehow outdone herself with this gorgeous and thoroughly original rendition of the beloved Louisa May Alcott classic. Bringing her effusive humor, authenticity, and irresistible warmth to the otherwise mannered Civil War-era New England, Gerwig's adaptation of LITTLE WOMEN breathes visceral new life into the March sisters – portraying them as unique, complicated, flawed, and astonishingly human. So human that you will leave the theater wanting to text Jo March and, for several reasons, this will not be a possibility.

You may also find it physically impossible not to chef's kiss at the cast, which is as close to pitch-perfect as it gets. Starring Saoirse Ronan as Jo, Emma Watson as Meg, Florence Pugh as Amy, and Eliza Scanlen as Beth, LITTLE WOMEN also features Laura Dern (!), Meryl Streep (!), Bob Odenkirk (!), and Timothée Chalamet as the dashing but lovelorn Laurie (!!!).

Save for a fireworks show, sky-written ode, or Mount Rushmore-type situation, we cannot recommend this rich, heartrending wonder of a film anymore. Its timeless charm is sure to capture the hearts of little women (and men) everywhere.

movies.title: Look Back
movies.cast: Natsuki Deguchi, Aju Makita, Furi Nanase, Rokka Okada
movies.description: Palme d’Or winner Kore-eda’s ( Shoplifters, Monster ) latest, adapted from the beloved manga, is a love letter to the artistic process and a meditation on friendship. Confident grade-schooler Fujino’s comics are adored by her classmates. But one day, her work is upstaged by a reclusive peer. When the two girls finally meet, however, Fujino discovers that the other girl has been her devoted fan all along. Bound by their shared passion, they become the closest of artistic collaborators, until a fateful event changes their lives forever.

movies.title: Lucid
movies.cast: Philip Albrecht Bartels, Danny Rohrback
movies.description:
It’s 1994, and art student Mia Sunshine Jones must pass her self portrait project or be kicked out of school. The problem is that she can’t seem to figure out who the hell she really is!

She is desperate to break free of her terrible creative block and finds her last hope in a magical Lucid Dreaming Elixir. The potion sparks her creativity but also unleashes dark monsters from her subconscious. As Mia battles these creatures, including a Fried Chicken Monster, her art flourishes! When her estranged mother appears as a hairy monster, Mia must face the truth about her past.

movies.title: Lunar Sway

movies.title: L’Innocente
movies.cast: Giancarlo Giannini, Laura Antonelli, Jennifer O’Neill In Italian with English subtitles
movies.description: A loose adaptation of Gabriele D’Annunzio’s 1892 novel, L’INNOCENTE is set in aristocratic Rome at the turn of the 20th century, wealthy and self-absorbed nobleman Tullio Hermil (Giannini) carries on an affair with a sophisticated yet possessive widow, Countess Teresa Raffo (O’Neill), while treating his devoted wife, Giuliana (Antonelli), with cold condescension. Wounded by his years of neglect, Giuliana takes a lover of her own with young novelist, Filippo (Marc Porel). When she becomes pregnant with Filippo’s child, Tullio’s wounded pride cannot be contained, setting off a chain of events leading to ultimate tragedy.

movies.title: Mars Attacks!
movies.cast: Jack Nicholson, Glenn Close, Annette Bening, Pierce Brosnan, Danny DeVito, Martin Short
movies.description:
How do you follow the success of gargantuan blockbusters like BATMAN and BATMAN RETURNS? Well, if you’re oddball director Tim Burton, you decide to make a campy, violent, big-budget alien invasion comedy based on a series of sci-fi trading cards from the 1960s.

With an absurdly star-studded cast, including Pierce Brosnan, Glenn Close, Annette Bening, Danny DeVito, Michael J. Fox, Martin Short, Natalie Portman, Jack Black, Sarah Jessica Parker's head on a chihuahua’s body, and Jack Nicholson in two different roles, MARS ATTACKS! is a demented piece of retro-pop madness that represents Tim Burton at his very best. If you've never seen this epic, raucously funny cult classic, don't miss your chance to experience it on the big screen.

movies.title: Meet Me in St. Louis
movies.cast: Judy Garland, Margaret O’Brien, Mary Astor, Lucille Bremer, Leon Ames Meet Me in St. Louis is a classic MGM romantic musical comedy that focuses on four sisters (one of whom is the nonpareil Judy Garland) on the cusp of the 1904 St. Louis World’s Fair. The film spotlights the sisters’ education in the ways of the world, which includes, but isn’t limited to, learning about life and love, courtesy of the prototypical boy next door. In the end, love — accompanied by song, dance and period costumes, all in glorious Technicolor — conquers all.
movies.description: A year in the life of a turn-of-the-century middle class family, leading up to the opening of the 1904 St. Louis World's Fair.

movies.title: Megalopolis
movies.cast: Adam Driver, Giancarlo Esposito, Nathalie Emmanuel, Aubrey Plaza, Shia LaBeouf, Jon Voight
movies.description:
Like the famed empire that Francis Ford Coppola’s epic passion project is styled after, MEGALOPOLIS is a towering, monumental spectacle that most people will think about at least once a day. The City of New Rome is at a crossroads. At one end sits Cesar Catilina (Adam Driver), the idealistic artist striving for a utopian future, and at the other sits Mayor Franklin Cicero (Giancarlo Esposito), a powerful figure perpetuating greed, special interests, and partisan warfare. Their titanic struggle will shake the foundations of their city and lay the groundwork for a new tomorrow.

As engrossing and ambitious as you would expect from the filmmaker behind THE GODFATHER and APOCALYPSE NOW, MEGALOPOLIS is an unforgettable vision that could only have come from Coppola. Of course, he didn’t do it alone, and everyone in the unbelievable cast (including Driver, Esposito, Nathalie Emmanuel, Aubrey Plaza, Laurence Fishburne, and more) delivers some of the most memorable performances of their careers.

movies.title: Metropolis
movies.cast: Alfred Abel, Brigitte Helm, Gustav Fröhlich, Rudolf Klein-Rogge
movies.description: Incorporating more than 25 minutes of newly discovered footage, this 2010 restoration of Metropolis is the definitive edition of Fritz Lang’s science fiction masterpiece. Backed by a new recording of Gottfried Huppertz’s 1927 score (presented here in 5.1 Stereo Surround), the film’s dazzling visual design and special effects are more striking than ever. And the integration of scenes and subplots long considered lost endows Metropolis with even greater tension and emotional resonance, as it dramatizes the conflict between wealthy über-capitalists and rebellious subterranean laborers—orchestrated by a diabolical scientist capable of destroying them both.

movies.title: Millennium Actress
movies.cast: Miyoko Shôji, Shôzô Îzuka, Mami Koyama
movies.description:
Experience the gorgeous new restoration of what many believe to be Satoshi Kon’s ( Perfect Blue, Paprika, Tokyo Godfathers ) greatest work, Millennium Actress .

When the legendary Ginei Studios shuts down, filmmaker Genya Tachibana and his assistant are tasked with interviewing its reclusive star, Chiyoko Fujiwara, who had retired from the spotlight 30 years prior. As she recounts her career, Genya and his crew are literally pulled into her memories where they witness her chance encounter with a mysterious man on the run from the police. Despite never knowing his name or his face, Chiyoko relentlessly pursues that man in a seamless blend of reality and memory that only Satoshi Kon could deliver.

Boasting countless awards, including the Grand Prize in the Japan Agency of Cultural Affairs Media Arts Festival, which it shared with Hayao Miyazaki’s Spirited Away , Millennium Actress is a must-see for anime fans of all ages.

movies.title: Misery
movies.cast: Kathy Bates, James Caan, Richard Farnsworth, Lauren Bacall, Frances Sternhagen, Graham Jarvis
movies.description: Imagine any artist's worst nightmare of running into a crazed "#1 fan" who takes you hostage and forces you to "dance like a monkey" to play out their own sadistic fantasies. Maybe Stephen King was thinking about this when writing MISERY, a book and movie about a famous author (James Caan) who gets into a violent car accident and is then saved, coincidentally, by his "#1 fan." What unfolds is an absolute nightmare of seclusion, captivity, and abuse that reaches a boiling climax of white-knuckle suspense! This is easily one of the best King adaptions.

movies.title: Moulin Rouge!
movies.cast: Ewan McGregor, Nicole Kidman, John Leguizamo, Jim Broadbent, Richard Roxburgh, Garry McDonald

Your heart will swell! Your lungs will burst! Your brain will explode with rainbows! Bring a date, or else make sure you choose your seat carefully because you WILL end up falling in love with the person sitting next to you.

movies.title: Mystery Transmission

Warm up the cathode tubes, dim the lights, and let your senses intermingle with the glow.

movies.title: National Lampoon's Christmas Vacation

movies.description:
Mele-ki-liki-maka is Hawaii's way to say Merry Christmas to you.

Bad luck seems to follow Clark Griswold and his family no matter where they go or what they do. The perpetual optimist, Clark (the young and great Chevy Chase) tries to make the holidays a special family event by chopping down the biggest tree in the forest, hanging a million Christmas lights, and dealing with his obnoxious visiting family members. He does this all while banking on his holiday bonus – but will it come?

Is NATIONAL LAMPOON'S CHRISTMAS VACATION a perfect Christmas movie? Yes.

movies.title: Nuisance Bear
movies.cast: Mike Tunalaaq Gibbons, Saad Kassis-Mohamed
movies.description:
Winner of the U.S. Documentary Grand Jury Prize at the Sundance Film Festival and hailed by Werner Herzog as “truly groundbreaking”, Nuisance Bear places viewers inside the world of a polar bear to deliver a cinematic pressure cooker and an urgent parable for our times.

Filmmakers Gabriela Osio Vanden and Jack Weisman follow a polar bear in Churchill, Manitoba — the self-styled “Polar Bear Capital of the World” — forced to navigate tourists, wildlife officers and hunters as climate change pushes it into town.

Guided by Inuit narrator Mike Tunalaaq Gibbons, whose perspective resists simplification, Nuisance Bear overturns the conventions of the nature documentary to ask: when a sacred predator is branded a “nuisance,” who truly belongs in this shared landscape?

movies.title: Once Upon a Time in Harlem
movies.cast: Aaron Douglas, Richard Bruce Nugent, Ernest Crichlow, Eubie Blake, Leigh Whipper, Arna Bontemps
movies.description:
A decade after his death, genre-defying filmmaker William Greaves has one last trick up his sleeve with what he considered the most important event he captured on film: a 1972 party he engineered with the living luminaries of the Harlem Renaissance. For four hours, this extraordinary group – many of whom had not seen each other in fifty years – reminisced, critiqued, argued, laughed and drank while wrestling with their place in a rapidly shifting cultural landscape.

Shot on 16mm film, newly restored and now directed by Greaves’ son David, this landmark film is at once a self-exploration and an inquiry into the heart of the critical mass of energy called the Harlem Renaissance. William Greaves’ intent was not only to document these artists and intellectuals as they spoke about their lives and work but also to plumb the meaning of the extraordinary creative period in which they lived to help us better understand how culture has been passed on from one generation to another and the role that the artist plays in keeping it alive.

movies.title: Orlando

After a disastrous affair with Russian princess Sasha (Charlotte Valandrey), Orlando looks for solace in the arts before being appointed ambassador to Constantinople in 1700, where war is raging. One morning, Orlando is shocked to wake up as a woman and returns home, struggling as a female to retain her property as the centuries roll by.

movies.title: Prince 3121 Las Vegas Live
movies.cast: Jennifer Lopez
movies.description: Prepare for an electrifying, once-in-a-lifetime concert experience as Prince commands the stage in 3121 Las Vegas Live. At the height of his legendary Las Vegas residency, Prince delivers a breathtaking showcase of unparalleled musicianship, explosive energy, dazzling guitar work, and unforgettable performances. Blending funk, rock, soul, R&B, and pop, he tears through hits, fan favorites, deep cuts, and extended jams with the spontaneity and brilliance that defined Prince as one of the greatest performers of all time. Whether you've been a lifelong Prince fan or are discovering his genius for the first time, this is Prince unleashed, and an essential experience for every generation.

Burnt out by the LA adult film scene, washed-up porn star Mikey Saber (Simon Rex) heads back to his old stomping grounds in small-town Texas. After a not-so-successful attempt at reconnecting with his estranged wife, Lexi (Bree Elrod), he forms an instant connection with Strawberry (Suzanna Son). Soon he’s juggling jealous exes, new love, and drug-dealing locals, all with a smile on his face. Who says you can’t go home again?

The audacious new film from writer-director Sean Baker (THE FLORIDA PROJECT, TANGERINE), starring Simon Rex in a magnetic, live-wire performance, RED ROCKET is a darkly funny and humane portrait of a uniquely American hustler and the hometown that barely tolerates him.

movies.title: Red Snow
movies.cast: Hannu-Pekka Björkman, Anni Iikkanen, Tommi Korpela, Krista Kosonen, Kari Hietalahti, Jussi Vatanen
movies.description: RED SNOW takes place in Finland, where 16-year-old emo teen Johanna dreams of a glittering Twilight vampire prince. What she gets instead is Martti, a balding, beer-bellied 49-year-old bloodsucker who slips into a Santa suit to gain entry to homes and devour entire families. When Johanna crosses paths with Martti on Christmas Eve, she thinks her dark fairy tale has come true. But instead of eternal romance, she finds herself trapped in a bloody and horrific nightmare of family trauma and festive slaughter. By morning, the snow will turn red.

movies.title: Romeo + Juliet
movies.cast: Leonardo DiCaprio, Claire Danes, Jesse Bradford, Vondie Curtis-Hall, Brian Dennehy, John Leguizamo
movies.description:
"Dost thou get it?" asked the TV commercials for director Baz Luhrmann's ROMEO + JULIET in the fall of 1996. For millions of young moviegoers, the answer was definitely yes: they were spellbound by the allure of Leonardo DiCaprio and Claire Danes (both so amazingly young and fresh-faced!) as Shakespeare's star-crossed couple.

Most viewers also enjoyed Luhrmann's wildly outside-the-box depiction of the Capulets and the Montagues as feuding mafia-style families in violent Verona Beach, where gangsters and hipsters rule the bullet-riddled streets. Five years before MOULIN ROUGE!, Luhrmann introduced the world to his pop-operatic style, incorporating gorgeous visuals, stunning sets, and modern hits like the Cardigans' "Lovefool," club classics like Kym Mazelle's cover of "Young Hearts Run Free," and even a choral version of Prince's "When Doves Cry" into his romantic tapestry. This was a far cry from the stuffy, stilted Shakespeare most of us snoozed through in school; even if you couldn't understand every phrase, Luhrmann made sure you got the meaning.

The movie was an international hit, and DiCaprio and Danes – both better known for their TV appearances than their movies at this point – would, of course, go on to have extraordinary careers. Twenty years later, ROMEO + JULIET remains one of the liveliest, most imaginative, and surprisingly moving interpretations of the Bard ever to hit the screen.

movies.title: Rose
movies.cast: Emmanuel Macchia, Valentin Campagne
movies.description:
We only imagine and invent ourselves.

Oscar® nominee Sandra Hüller ( Anatomy of a Fall , The Zone of Interest ) takes on her most powerful role yet in ROSE, writer-director Markus Schleinzer’s transcendent new film.

In 17th century Germany, a mysterious soldier arrives in an isolated village, laying claim to an abandoned farmstead with the intent to settle down. Unbeknownst to the residents, this outsider is Rose, born a woman yet living as a man. Upon moving in and resolutely taming the land, he realizes the sole way to secure his position is to marry into the community. Yet taking a wife (Caro Braun) gives rise to suspicions even as they grow close, propelling events towards a reckoning.

Meticulously rendered in stunning black-and-white, ROSE transports us to a world unlike any other to convey the universal value of personal freedom. In her Silver Bear-winning star turn, Sandra Hüller embodies a self-defining protagonist whose profound fluidity and humanity resonates through the past and into the present. Matching this emphatic performance with exquisite technique, Austria’s Best International Feature Film entry to the 99th Academy Awards® is a boundary-breaking fable from a true craftsman.

Official Austrian submission, Academy Awards.

movies.title: Shouting at the Screen
movies.description:
The end of an era is upon us. After 15 years of shouting, we have finally lost our voices.

So let’s gather one last time to watch a bit of Blaxploitation and point out some of its most utterly ridiculous tropes.

It’s been an absolute joy to share these films with you and reframe that boom mic dangling from the corner of the frame, terrible fight scene or overdramatic death within the context of what it actually is: art.

Our only hope is that after this event series you are a little kinder to the people at theaters who talk back at films because it just might be one of us jonesin’ for a fix.

After tonight may all of your films be shout-less!

movies.cast: Roy Scheider, Bruno Cremer, Francisco Rabal, Amidou
movies.description:
An American oil company located in a South American town is looking for drivers to haul nitroglycerine over the rugged terrain. Four expatriated men who have nothing to lose take on the job, for which they’ll each be given $10,000 and the reward of legal citizenship if they live.

Staff pick by Keith M, usher

Screening as part of our series Staff Picks 2026

Previously screened as part of our 2023 retrospective William Friedkin: Fate and Faith .

movies.title: Spider-Man "Brand New" Brand New Day
movies.cast: Tom Holland, Sadie Sink, Tramell Tillman, Zendaya, Jacob Batalon, Jon Bernthal
movies.description: The record-breaking movie is coming back to the big screen on December 4th with an extended cut featuring new scenes and a couple more surprises.

movies.title: Spoons Toons & Booze XMAS After Dark
Sundays on Fire: Secret Hong Kong 35mm Feature
movies.description:
Warning: Images are not from the movies we’re showing. Trust us, you can’t imagine what we’re showing!

A career-making film from the late-90s, this caper flick rarely gets screened, but it turned out to be a landmark for both its director and its stars. An anthem to urban loneliness, job dissatisfaction, and unconsummated romance, it’s as light on its feet as Ocean’s 11 , as stylish as North By Northwest , and as heart-achingly emotional as a Cantopop power ballad. Featuring two of Hong Kong’s biggest stars playing lonely men who re-discover their love of life by shooting at each other, it’s a rousing, ridiculous, over-the-top supernova of fun, that reminds us this holiday season that what we have to be thankful for are Hong Kong movies.
notes: Presented in 35mm

movies.title: Tender Loving Care
movies.cast: Marion Bailey, Paul Jesson, Kate O'Flynn, Alice Bailey Johnson, Tilly Vosburgh, Alan Williams
movies.description: As the demands of work and family begin to converge, two best-friend social workers and those closest to them discover the strength found in compassion, community, and one another. Set in post-Brexit England, Mike Leigh’s Tender Loving Care is a richly observed portrait of resilience, humor, and the enduring power of human connection. “As great as anything he’s ever produced,” The Daily Beast proclaims of the feature that might be Leigh’s last, “a small-scale domestic drama that reverberates loudly, and urgently, as a celebration of everyday compassion and solidarity.”

movies.title: Thank God It's Friday
movies.cast: Jeff Goldblum, Raymond Vitte, Debra Winger, Valerie Landsburg, Terri Nunn, Chick Vennera
movies.description: It's Friday night, and everyone who's anyone is converging at The Zoo, LA's hottest disco. There's a dance contest going down, and nobody is letting that prize money go easy. Featuring the Commodores, Donna Summer, and a pre-Berlin Terri Nunn, this utterly silly musical comedy is a true gem of the disco era.

movies.title: The Apartment
movies.cast: Jack Lemmon, Shirley MacLaine, Fred MacMurray, Ray Walston, Jack Kruschen, David Lewis
movies.description:
A young upstart, C.C. Baxter (Jack Lemmon), will do anything to move up in the world...even loan out his apartment to the higher-ups for their romantic flings and extramarital trysts. All seems relatively fine and dandy until C.C. finds a romance of his own.

Billy Wilder is a genius – there aren't enough words in the world to describe all the films he's made and express how much he means to cinema – but in 1960, Wilder wrote and directed a perfect movie. I'm not saying this to sell you on the idea of seeing this film at the Alamo; I'm stating it as a fact. There are very few instances where you watch a movie and realize you are witnessing pure magnificence in that moment. Sometimes you think about a movie after the fact, and it gets better and better until you begin to love a movie you previously only really liked. THE APARTMENT is NOT one of those movies. It is a movie where, within 15 minutes of watching, you realize it is unlike anything you have ever seen before. Jack Lemmon is amazing, Shirley MacLaine is a full-on pixie dream girl, and the chemistry and dialogue snap and sparkle like you wouldn't believe.

movies.title: The Bells of St. Mary’s
movies.cast: Ingrid Bergman, Bing Crosby, Henry Travers, William Gargan
movies.description: “Crosby is Father O’Malley, a swaggering and indecently rakish (he wears a tilted boater and has a catchphrase—‘Just dial O for O’Malley!’) inner-city pastor who has been assigned to a failing parish. Bergman is the prim Sister Mary Benedict, who frequently clashes with O’Malley (‘Did anyone ever tell you that you have a dishonest face?’ she snaps), while secretly nurturing feelings of admiration, and more. Nothing, of course, is expressed. It’s all in the looks and between the lines. But it’s there.” – The Times (UK)

movies.title: The Big Lebowski
movies.cast: Jeff Bridges, John Goodman, Julianne Moore, Steve Buscemi, David Huddleston, John Turturro, Philip Seymour Hoffman, Sam Elliott, Tara Reid
movies.description: Jeff "The Dude" Lebowski doesn't want any drama in his life…heck, he can't even be bothered with a job. But when his rug is destroyed in a twisted case of mistaken identity, he embarks on a quest for restitution with his bowling buddies.
notes: Preceded by the restored “Superman” short The Arctic Giant from Fleischer Studios.

movies.title: The Big Sleep
movies.cast: Humphrey Bogart, Lauren Bacall, Martha Vickers, Dorothy Malone
movies.description: When private investigator Philip Marlowe (Bogart) accepts the blackmail case of one of Los Angeles' wealthiest men, his probe leads deep into a web of lies, drugs, pornography and murder woven around his client's two beautiful daughters. But Marlowe's most startling discovery is his inexorable attraction to one of the sisters.
notes: Presented in 35mm
35mm print!
Preceded by the restored “Superman” short The Bulleteers from Fleischer Studios.

movies.title: The Debut
movies.cast: Julianne Moore, Paul Giamatti, Halle Bailey, Jesse Eisenberg, Cara Buono, Craig Bierko, Bernadette Peters
movies.description: When Mona Friedman is cast in a bit part at a small community theater, she transforms from a shy, unassuming housewife into a zealous method actor willing to do anything to protect the artistic integrity of her marginal role–even if it means waging war against the show’s domineering director.

movies.title: The Debut
movies.cast: Julianne Moore, Paul Giamatti, Halle Bailey, Jesse Eisenberg, Bernadette Peters, Craig Bierko
movies.description: When Mona Friedman (Julianne Moore) is cast in a bit part at a small community theater, she transforms from a shy, unassuming housewife into a zealous method actor willing to do anything to protect the artistic integrity of her marginal role—even if it means waging war against the show’s domineering director, Jerry Blankenbuehler (Paul Giamatti). “You are watching a woman who can’t act being played by a woman who very much can,” the Daily Telegraph reports, “and the result is as psychologically scrambling as it is spiritually elating.”

movies.title: The Departed
movies.cast: Leonardo DiCaprio, Matt Damon, Jack Nicholson, Mark Wahlberg, Martin Sheen, Ray Winstone
movies.description:
"If they're lucky, directors make one classic film in their career. Martin Scorsese has one per decade (TAXI DRIVER in the '70s, RAGING BULL in the '80s, GOODFELLAS in the '90s). His 2006 Irish Mafia masterpiece kept the streak alive." – Entertainment Weekly

In South Boston, the state police force is waging war on Irish-American organized crime. Young undercover cop Billy Costigan (Leonardo DiCaprio) is assigned to infiltrate the mob syndicate run by gangland chief Frank Costello (Jack Nicholson). While Billy quickly gains Costello's confidence, Colin Sullivan (Matt Damon), a hardened young criminal who has infiltrated the state police as an informer for the syndicate, is rising to a position of power in the Special Investigation Unit. Each man becomes deeply consumed by his double life, gathering information about the plans and counter-plans of the operations he has penetrated. But when it becomes clear to both the mob and the police that there's a mole in their midst, Billy and Colin are suddenly in danger of being caught and exposed to the enemy – and each must race to uncover the identity of the other man in time to save himself. But is either willing to turn on the friends and comrades they've made during their long stints undercover?

movies.title: The Friend’s House Is Here
movies.cast: Mahshad Bahram, Hana Mana, Farzad Karen, Zohreh Pirnia, Parham Ghanavat, Erfan Tehranifar
movies.description: In Tehran’s underground art scene, Pari, a theater director, and Hanna, a dancer, are roommates, best friends, actors, and professional partners, navigating rehearsals, performances, and the quiet rituals of everyday life while confronting the ethical compromises and political pressures that increasingly shape their futures. Shot in secret but far removed from familiar portrayals of Iran, directors Ataei and Keshavarz blur the boundaries between theatrical performance and lived experience, crafting a luminous portrait of sisterhood where art becomes inseparable from life and even the smallest creative choices can become acts of resistance.

movies.title: The History of Concrete
movies.cast: John Wilson, Michael Imperioli, Jack Macco, Nathan Fielder, Timothée Chalamet, Josh Safdie
movies.description: Following the finale of his acclaimed HBO series, How To with John Wilson , documentarian John Wilson looks to the bedrock of his beloved New York City for inspiration and structure. Concrete, the world's most widely used building material, appears as an ever-present life force, and John sets out to make the definitive documentary on the matter. After attending a workshop on how to write and sell a Hallmark movie, he decides to use the industry-approved Hallmark formula to tell this seemingly drab story and increase his movie’s appeal. But his foundation soon begins to crumble—literally and figuratively—as he struggles to balance artistic freedom with the realities of the modern film industry.

movies.title: The Holiday
movies.cast: Cameron Diaz, Kate Winslet, Jude Law, Jack Black, Eli Wallach, Edward Burns
movies.description: Two women, one (Cameron Diaz) from America and one (Kate Winslet) from Britain, swap homes at Christmastime after bad breakups with their boyfriends. Each woman finds romance with a local man (Jude Law, Jack Black) but realizes that the imminent return home may end the relationship.

movies.title: The Holiday
movies.cast: Cameron Diaz, Kate Winslet, Jude Law, Jack Black, Eli Wallach, Edward Burns
movies.description: We could all use an escape every now and then. That’s certainly true for Amanda (Cameron Diaz) and Iris (Kate Winslet), two strangers who connect online and temporarily swap houses as a means of escaping from the stresses of their lives. And we’re inviting you to escape with us for a little bit with this special screening of Nancy Meyers’ utterly charming rom-com, THE HOLIDAY. With charismatic movie stars, enchanting settings, and a heaping helping of humor and romance, it’ll feel like a mini-vacation in the middle of your busy season.

movies.title: The Last Waltz
movies.cast: Robbie Robertson, Rick Danko, Levon Helm, Richard Manuel, Garth Hudson, Eric Clapton
movies.description: Seventeen years after joining forces as the backing band for rockabilly cult hero Ronnie Hawkins, Canadian roots rockers The Band call it quits with a lavish farewell show at San Francisco’s Winterland Ballroom on Nov. 25, 1976. Filmed by Martin Scorsese, this documentary features standout performances by rock legends such as Bob Dylan, Van Morrison, Eric Clapton, Joni Mitchell and Muddy Waters, as well as interviews tracing the group’s history and discussing road life.

movies.title: The Maltese Falcon
movies.cast: Humphrey Bogart, Mary Astor, Gladys George, Peter Lorre, Barton MacLane, Lee Patrick, Sydney Greenstreet
movies.description: Academy Award winner Humphrey Bogart stars in this classic film noir as tough San Francisco private detective Sam Spade in the classic, convoluted story of Spade's involvement with a deadly band of international thieves who will lie, double cross and murder to obtain a small, jewel-encrusted statue known as The Maltese Falcon. Sam Spade's (Bogart) partner, Miles Archer (Jerome Cowan), accepts a job protecting a young woman (Mary Astor). Neither Spade nor Archer believe the woman or the story she tells them, but they do believe her money. Then, when Archer is murdered, Spade's search for the killer drags him in the web of lies and death spun by the desperate people seeking The Maltese Falcon.
notes: Presented in 35mm
35mm print, preserved by the Library of Congress.
Preceded by the restored “Superman” short Billion Dollar Limited from Fleischer Studios.

movies.title: THE Parent Trap
movies.cast: Lindsay Lohan, Natasha Richardson, Dennis Quaid
movies.description: “ THE PARENT TRAP is based on story elements so ancient and foolproof, they must have their roots in Shakespeare’s day: the twins changing places, their divorced parents falling in love again, and, for low comedy, their servants falling in love, too. And of course there’s a wicked would-be stepmother lurking about. The story is ageless and so is the gimmick: The twins are played by the same actress, using trick photography. Hayley Mills did it in 1961, and Lindsay Lohan does it this time, seamlessly. One twin is American, one is British, but even their accents don’t help us tell them apart, since half of the time they’re pretending to be each other. ‘I’ll teach you to be me, and you teach me to be you,’ one twin says, after they meet by chance at summer camp and realize that they’ve been raised separately by divorced parents. It’s a splendid story premise, but in a way, the switch is just the setup, and the real story involves the parents. They’re played by Dennis Quaid and Natasha Richardson, who bring such humor and warmth to the movie that I was amazed to find myself actually caring about their romance. ” – Roger Ebert

movies.title: The Polar Express
movies.cast: Tom Hanks, Leslie Zemeckis, Eddie Deezen, Nona Gaye, Peter Scolari, Michael Jeter
movies.description:
Tom Hanks and director Robert Zemeckis (FORREST GUMP, CAST AWAY) reunite for THE POLAR EXPRESS, an inspiring adventure based on the beloved children's book by Chris Van Allsburg. When a doubting young boy takes an extraordinary train ride to the North Pole, he embarks on a journey of self-discovery that shows him that the wonder of life never fades for those who believe.

We believe...do you?
notes: Join us for a family adventure aboard THE POLAR EXPRESS!

movies.title: The Shining
movies.cast: Jack Nicholson, Shelley Duvall, Danny Lloyd, Scatman Crothers
movies.description: Stanley Kubrick’s filmic version of Stephen King’s novel The Shining is the most beautiful mash up of terror that includes architecture, madness, a time/space collapse, and surreal imagery. The Shining takes place essentially in one place, The Overlook Hotel, that Jack Torrance (starring Here’s Johnny! Jack Nicholson) shares with his wife and psychic son as caretakers for the winter. It doesn’t take long for the hotel to consume his thoughts and propel him to do the unthinkable…murder his family.

movies.title: The Shining
movies.cast: Jack Nicholson, Shelley Duvall, Danny Lloyd, Scatman Crothers
movies.description:
An alcoholic, out-of-work teacher takes a job as the wintertime caretaker of a snowy resort. He brings his wife and young son with him. He wants to get some writing done. Things take a very dark turn...

THE SHINING is Stanley Kubrick’s chilling symphony of deft manipulation: Wendy Carlos’ score alternating with Ligeti compositions, Jack Nicholson and Shelley Duvall’s push-and-pull performances, and the omniscient Steadicam taking the whole thing in. THE SHINING transcends any trappings of paperback adaptation or genre exercise to become one of the most elementally terrifying works of art of the 20th century. Come lose yourself in its marvelous madness on the big screen, where it forever belongs.

movies.title: The Shop Around the Corner
movies.cast: Margaret Sullavan, James Stewart, Frank Morgan, Joseph Schildkraut
movies.description:
Programmer Shay Filmore tackles her watchlist anxiety through the series My First Time . This program features films Shay hasn’t seen but fall into the specific category of “movies you know you’ll probably love, but you hold off seeing because you really want to see them in the theater.”

For the second screening, prepare to get cozy in chilly Budapest for Ernst Lubitsch’s 1940 Christmastime classic The Shop Around the Corner .

Holiday genres are very funny. Every horror film is essentially part of the Halloween canon, yet comparatively few Christmas movies exist. In fact, we are always quick to enthusiastically claim that something is a Christmas movie just because it has one scene set during the holidays (like Lorene Scafaria’s 2019 masterpiece Hustlers ). This makes Shay’s oversight even more baffling since there aren’t really that many Christmas films to begin with.

In pre-war Budapest, two employees at a leather goods shop can barely stand each other, without realizing that they are falling in love through the post as each other’s anonymous pen pal.

Join Shay in your favorite holiday attire as she watches The Shop Around the Corner … for the first time!

movies.title: The Texas Chainsaw Massacre
movies.cast: Marilyn Burns, Gunnar Hansen, Edwin Neal, Paul A. Partain, Allen Danziger
movies.description:
50 years ago, five youths on a weekend getaway in the Texas countryside fell prey to a butcher in a mask made of human skin and his cannibalistic family, and horror cinema would never be the same. Violent, confrontational, and shockingly realistic, director Tobe Hooper’s THE TEXAS CHAIN SAW MASSACRE terrified audiences in a way never thought possible when it was unleashed on a politically and socially tumultuous America in 1974. Facing a storm of controversy, censorship, and outcry throughout its troubled release, this masterpiece of horror has stood the test of time to become a landmark motion picture and cultural milestone.

Staff pick by Anthony

Screening as part of our series Staff Picks 2026

movies.title: The Thing
movies.cast: Kurt Russell, Wilford Brimley, T.K. Carter, David Clennon, Keith David, Richard Dysart
movies.description:
In the winter of 1982, a twelve-man research team at a remote Antarctic research station discovers an alien buried in the snow for over 100,000 years. Once unfrozen, the form-changing alien wreaks havoc, creates terror and becomes one of them.

Screening as part of Late Night Favorites: Fall 2026

Previously screened as part of our 2025 series Waverly Midnights: Winter Vacation our Autumn 2019 series, “ Waverly Midnights: Late-Night Favorites .”

movies.title: To Hold a Mountain
movies.cast: Mileva Gara Jovanović, Nada Stanišić
movies.description: The highlands of Montenegro are the breathtaking setting for this story of mother Gara and teenage daughter Nada, who tend to sheep and cows, gather herbs, and make cheese every summer. The Sinjajevina plateau is a remote, sacred, ancestral pasture, yet the modern world intrudes in the form of an incongruous government plan to install a NATO military shooting range there. Filming over seven years, co-directors Tutorov and Glomazić vividly capture the indefatigable efforts of Gara to cultivate support from her neighbors to guard the land that benefits them all, as Nada learns hard truths about her family’s history.

movies.title: Trouble in Paradise
movies.cast: Herbert Marshall, Kay Francis, Miriam Hopkins
movies.description: “You are a crook. I want you as a crook. I love you as a crook. I worship you as a crook.” Partners in crime and romance, Herbert Marshall (Gaston) and Miriam Hopkins (Lily) hatch a plan to rob perfume executive Kay Francis (Mariette), sending Gaston in as personal secretary to their employer. The plan is afoot and the joint is cased... until Gaston falls in love with Mariette and is forced to choose in a film that pairs grace and elegance with swindling and social vulgarities.
notes: Presented in 35mm

movies.title: UFC 335: Oliveira vs. Lopes
movies.description: UFC 335: OLIVEIRA VS. LOPES is the highly anticipated final event of 2026, taking place on December 12 at the T-Mobile Arena in Las Vegas, Nevada. The event is headlined by a spectacular lightweight clash as former champion Charles Oliveira defends his BMF title against featherweight sensation Diego Lopes, who is making his first appearance in the lightweight division.

movies.title: Violent Night 2
movies.cast: David Harbour, Kristen Bell, Daniela Melchior, Jared Harris, Joe Pantoliano, Maxwell Jacob Friedman
movies.description: David Harbour reprises his role as Santa Claus in a propulsive new chapter in yuletide mayhem from 87North, as not-so-jolly Saint Nick suits up again to take on a ruthless gangster terrorizing the merchants of the Silver Bell Mall.

movies.title: Werwulf
movies.cast: Aaron Taylor-Johnson, Willem Dafoe, Lily-Rose Depp
movies.description: Witness Robert Eggers’ most visceral and haunting experience yet. Focus Features presents Werwulf , a harrowing tale of devotion, damnation and the devil within.

movies.title: Werwulf
movies.cast: Aaron Taylor-Johnson, Willem Dafoe, Lily-Rose Depp
movies.description: Experience Robert Eggers’ ( Nosferatu ) latest visceral and haunting vision. In a small rural village, local superstition becomes terrifyingly real when a ravenous creature begins to stalk the countryside. While a local farmer (Taylor-Johnson) struggles beneath the weight of a werewolf curse, a ruthless hunter (Dafoe) begins a campaign to eradicate wolves. A harrowing tale of devotion, damnation and the devil within.

movies.title: Werwulf
movies.cast: Aaron Taylor-Johnson, Willem Dafoe, Lily-Rose Depp
movies.description: Robert Eggers has never met a bleak 13th-century folktale he didn't want to translate onto the big screen. The filmmaker behind NOSFERATU, THE LIGHTHOUSE, and THE WITCH returns with a gothic horror tale of blood and damnation in 13th-century England, where apparently the sun has been permanently canceled. A fearsome beast stalks the countryside. Willem Dafoe hunts it. Aaron Taylor-Johnson becomes it. Shot on grainy, desaturated 35mm film, it’s one more moon, and one very Eggers way to spell werewolf.

movies.title: When Harry Met Sally...
movies.cast: Billy Crystal, Meg Ryan, Carrie Fisher, Bruno Kirby, Steven Ford, Lisa Jane Persky
movies.description:
We all know those couples. They see each other from across the room, they meet, and wham! They’re desperately in love.

That’s not the case for Harry and Sally. In fact, when they meet, they don’t particularly like each other. Sally is earnest and good. Harry is cynical and depressive. It’s not a match made in heaven.

But lovers of rom-coms know that opposites have a way of attracting.

With some of the most palpable on-screen chemistry in movie history, Billy Crystal and Meg Ryan take viewers on a journey through friendship, heartbreak, and the pitfalls of relationships with the help of expert direction from Rob Reiner, a pitch-perfect supporting cast (including Carrie Fisher and Bruno Kirby), and one of the best romantic comedy screenplays of all time from the brilliant Nora Ephron.

movies.title: Wto/99
movies.cast: Joan Claybrook, Bill Clinton
movies.description:
Building from a roughly 1,000 hour archive, WTO/99 reanimates the ideological conflicts that drew thousands to the streets of Seattle in hopes for a better future. The film is an immersive visual artifact of a week that brought 40,000 people together to warn of environmental collapse, the vanishing middle class, and what the full inclusion of China in the World Trade Organization would mean for our collective future. The protesters—seen as a rabble-rousing nuisance at the time, yet appearing prophetic today—were met with extreme violence by a militarized police force, an all-too-fitting way to usher in a new century; one that is now defined by US failure to address climate change and increasing state aggression.

This immersive archival documentary depicts the four-day clash between the then-emerging World Trade Organization (WTO) and the 40,000+ people who took to the streets of Seattle in 1999 to protest the WTO Conference and sound the alarm on the WTO’s impact on human rights, labor, and the future effects of continued globalization.

movies.title: Zero A.D.: The Birth of Christ
movies.cast: Deva Cassel, Jamie Ward, Jim Caviezel, Sam Worthington, Ben Mendelsohn, Gael García Bernal
movies.description: An empire in decay. A ruler consumed by fear. A star rising over Bethlehem. When Christ is born, Herod’s terror erupts into the slaughter of the innocents, and Mary must protect the child promised to save the world. As violence spreads and hope flickers, the true battle begins – not for a throne, but for the soul of mankind.

movies.title: Zodiac
movies.cast: Jake Gyllenhaal, Mark Ruffalo, Anthony Edwards, Robert Downey Jr., Chloë Sevigny, Elias Koteas
movies.description:
Based on the true story of one of America's greatest unsolved mysteries of one of its most notorious serial killers, ZODIAC is as much a story of obsession as it is a story of murder. In the ‘60s and ‘70s, the Zodiac was a serial killer in the San Francisco area who would routinely taunt the police with letters and ciphers in newspapers. One day, a young political cartoonist, Robert Graysmith (Jake Gyllenhaal), cracks one of the Zodiac’s ciphers and spirals into a sea of perpetual preoccupation with solving his riddles and finding out his true identity with the help of his co-worker/crime reporter friend Paul Avery (Robert Downey Jr.).

Always intrigued by the case while growing up in the Bay Area, the Zodiac was David Fincher’s “ultimate boogeyman.” Fincher set out with his screenwriter and producer to conduct an 18-month investigation into the unsolved case while rewriting the screenplay. The result is the story of a reporter determined to get the story at any cost. New to being an investigative reporter, he becomes all-consumed by his obsession to know the truth. Somehow along the way, it seems as though Fincher and company got caught up in that compulsion and created a spectacularly layered, investigative, and riveting narrative in their attempt to find a culprit posthumously.

This film was a technical marvel and a true cinematic masterpiece of Fincher’s career that, despite overwhelming positive reviews and an all-star cast, was left basically ignored by audiences. Don’t make the same mistake twice and miss your chance to get swept up in this gut-wrenching sea of anxiety!

movies.title: 14th
movies.cast: Sherrilyn Ifill, Stacey Abrams, Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez, Jeff Flake, Hasan Piker, Alex Padilla
movies.description: Revolves around the equal protection and citizenship-focused 14th amendment, which was ratified in 1868 in the turbulent era of Reconstruction and has been a contentious part of the American body politic ever since.
